# yii3-mcp-rbac-bridge

Per-user RBAC for rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp servers over the Yii3 auth stack:
permissions on tools/call, permission-aware tools/list, session-identity
binding. Application-facing alternative to OAuth 2.1.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-rbac-bridge
```

## Rules

- TWO auth layers: yii3-mcp SharedSecretMiddleware = machine auth (keep it!),
  this bridge = user auth. Route middleware order: SharedSecret ->
  Authentication (yiisoft/auth) -> McpAction.
- Restriction is explicit per-tool: tools without a mapped permission are
  unrestricted. #[RequiredPermission] without #[McpTool] on the same method
  => InvalidPermissionMapException at map build time (fail-fast). Same for
  one tool name mapped to two different permissions by attributes
  (explicit overrides win by design and are exempt).
- Tool name = map key. Derived exactly as yii3-mcp registers it: explicit
  #[McpTool(name)] wins; else the method name; for an invokable tool
  (#[McpTool] on __invoke, no name) the CLASS SHORT NAME, not "__invoke".
  fromToolClasses() computes keys for you; an EXPLICIT map/override must use
  that same runtime name (invokable => class short name) or the tool stays
  silently unrestricted.
- Session binding happens on the FIRST tools/call (the core interceptor
  chain does not see initialize); guests bind as guests and cannot be
  impersonated by a literal "guest" user id.
- Denials are regular MCP tool-error envelopes (agent sees the reason).

## API reference

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge\ {
    CurrentUserIdentitySource, IdentitySourceInterface, PermissionMap,
    RbacToolCallInterceptor, RbacToolVisibility, RequiredPermission,
    SessionIdentityInterceptor,
};

// Declaring:
#[McpTool(name: 'order.status')]
#[RequiredPermission('orders.view')]
public function status(string $orderId): string { ... }

// Map (tool name => permission); explicit overrides win over attributes:
$map = PermissionMap::fromToolClasses([OrderTools::class], ['ping' => 'monitoring.read']);
$map->permissionFor('order.status');   // 'orders.view' | null = unrestricted
// unknown class / empty names / misplaced attribute => Exception\InvalidPermissionMapException

// Enforcement (implements yii3-mcp ToolCallInterceptorInterface):
new RbacToolCallInterceptor($accessChecker, $identitySource, $map);
// $accessChecker: Yiisoft\Access\AccessCheckerInterface (bind your rbac Manager)
// guest (null id) => denied on mapped tools; unmapped tools pass through

// Listing (implements yii3-mcp Visibility\ToolVisibilityInterface):
new RbacToolVisibility($accessChecker, $identitySource, $map);
// same map + checker as the interceptor => list and call never disagree

// Session hijacking guard (implements ToolCallInterceptorInterface, put OUTERMOST):
new SessionIdentityInterceptor($identitySource);
// binds first identity to the session; different identity later =>
// tool error "MCP session is bound to a different identity"

// Identity:
interface IdentitySourceInterface { public function getId(): ?string; } // null = guest
new CurrentUserIdentitySource($currentUser);   // yiisoft/user CurrentUser

// yii3-mcp params wiring:
// 'interceptors' => [SessionIdentityInterceptor::class, RbacToolCallInterceptor::class],
// 'tool_visibility' => RbacToolVisibility::class,
// DI: IdentitySourceInterface => CurrentUserIdentitySource,
//     PermissionMap => static fn() => PermissionMap::fromToolClasses([...])
```
